DeployBot: Scheduled rollout for customer 'Harbor Sentinel' (Dedicated) on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Target: infra shard 'eu-west-2-a'. Release artifacts: release/v5.13.0. Pins: model=redwood/opt-13b@v2.2. KMS: customer-key-789 (requires rotation window confirmation). Rollback window: 30m after shift. Runbook: https://releases.internal/r/harbor-sentinel/v5.13.0

ana: quick q — does the release include the new batching kernel?

DeployBot: yes — kernel: batching-opt-v1.4 included. Backward-compatible fallback: batching-opt-v1.3.

sam: I want to confirm rollback criteria. Proposed: >2.5x tail latency vs baseline OR error rate >1% for 5m => rollback. also CPU/GPU OOMs immediate rollback.

liam: +1 to those thresholds. add quality regression gate: eval-prompt-set 'harbor-smoke' must pass >=98% token-completion match within 10m of shift.

morgan: KMS note: customer requested rotation at 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC. That completes 3h before cutover — ok? also need confirmation that private control plane has updated key ARN.

ryan: I'll validate KMS ARN and upload to staging tonight. pinging @morgan when done.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet:
```
# cutover steps (abridged)
1) drain slice S-14 on v5.12.3
2) pin traffic to v5.13.0 on 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m windows
3) monitor KPIs: p99 latency, error-rate, gpu-memory
4) if gate fails: revert weight to v5.12.3, scale up dedicated pool, notify customer
```

ana: who is primary on-call for rollback?

sam: I'll be primary for first 60m. @liam secondary. ryan for KMS issues.

morgan: can we add an automated fallback policy to route to same model quantized variant if throughput dips? i.e., redwood/opt-13b-quant@v2.2 as warm fallback.

liam: good idea. ops-runbook-bot, add fallback route config.

ops-runbook-bot: Fallback route added to runbook: route->quant-variant on sustained token latency >150ms for 2m.

ryan: KMS ARN validated in staging. Updated control plane config: kmsKey: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:222:customer/789

sam: verified canary smoke run on staging: p99=85ms, error=0.2%, eval-prompt-set pass=99%.

morgan: customer notified and approved 02:00 UTC window. They asked we keep 48h metric retention for this rollout.

ana: small ask — can we include a one-line release note for support?

sam: Release note: "v5.13.0: improved batching kernel, KV cache stability fixes, optional quantized fallback for throughput spikes."

liam: ack from me. :thumbsup:

ryan: KMS note: rotation confirmed, no pending key policies. :white_check_mark:

sam: OK we're green. Approving cutover. Safety pin: if p50 latency regresses >20% for 10m we pause and investigate.

morgan: i'm adding a tie-breaker: if customer reports degradation in first 30m we will initiate manual hold.

DeployBot: Cutover approved by: sam, liam, morgan, ryan. Scheduled at 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Safety-pin and rollback plan attached. Notifying oncall and customer. :rocket:
